en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's cook something
Let's bake something
Let's drink something
I'm not really hungry.

And food doesn't taste good when 
you force yourself to eat it...
So I'll pass for now...

If you're gonna make it, 
I can eat it for you.

And just to let you know, 
I can't cook with my magic.

I'm charging my mana in 
anticipation.

You'll be the baker and 
I'll be the eater.

Well, I guess if you want some tea, 
I could pour you some.

Nyeh!?
How did you know I was thirsty?

Don't tell me...can you use 
mind reading magic...?

So you've been using your magic...
to read my mind the whole time?

No wonder you've been such 
a considerate guy!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Himiko looks deep in thought...
(Nyeh...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Himiko's inner thoughts...?
